name: Public Marketing Page
user: Prospective customer/visitor on a public marketing surface.
primary_task: Understand the offering and take the primary conversion action (CTA).
visual_vocabulary: Hero (single h1 + subtitle + CTA Button link + optional media scrim)
accessibility: Exactly one h1 in the Hero (R-A11Y-03)
Newsletter form native label + aria-invalid on 422
content_rules: Primary CTA is an action verb (Get started)
Tone neutral professional; plain language, short titles
Factual marketing copy; no unverified universal claims

get_params.lang: locale code; GET ?lang= resolves 303 to the localized URL (Language Switcher)

server_contract.notes: Newsletter: POST + 422 X-Loom-Validation on invalid email (inline alert, value preserved); success re-renders a persistent role=status (example) or POST + 303 -> GET success (production). Language switcher is GET navigation, not a mutation.

no_js_flow: Complete: every CTA is a real link; the newsletter is a native POST form with 422 inline feedback; the language switcher is a GET form with a visible submit (zero auto-submit); the video uses native controls; footer sections use native details/summary.
htmx_enhancement: Optional: the newsletter aside may hx-swap on 200/422. No mutation contract change (R-NOJS-03).
responsive_behavior: Fluid grid (auto-fit/minmax) for feature cards; Hero and Split stack on narrow; footer grid -> stack; overlays n/a; no breakpoint-worship.
theme_requirements: Public patterns use tokens --ui-* only; zero color literals; forced-colors/reduced-motion by primitives; theme switcher stays 0-JS (?theme=).
alternatives_rejected: JS carousel for features: a fluid grid suffices (R-RESP-01)
Modal newsletter capture: inline aside + POST + 422 (R-OVERLAY-01)
Hero as 'Callout': naming collision resolved, Hero is promotional, Callout is the Phase D tip box
Auto-submit language switcher: visible submit required
rationale: Dogfoods the Phase F public patterns as the indexable single-screen flow of the protocol, validating R-SEO-01 and R-GEO-01 (clean canonical, JSON-LD) on the only indexable surface. Matches the implemented marketing home (internal/app/landing.go).
